messages.text: That teal curtain panel in clearance would actually hide your metal shelf situation.
Only if it fits between the rolling rack and the tripod pile. That corner is packed.
The clip you sent with the lady folding scarves over a hanger actually saved our messy endcap today lol
That lady with the silver flats came back for the green jacket after you moved it beside the cream tanks lol
I knew it. Her whole page is tiny rack fixes and little shop restock chaos.
I knew she was circling it. She kept touching the sleeve but only when it was away from the loud orange stuff.
Measure it before somebody buys it. Also save a pic in that future-place folder you keep making me look at.
Also the sound over that customer-return skit was TOO real. I heard it in my head when someone brought back a used candle.
Also your red-sticker front table was half empty by close. Mateo looked annoyed that it worked.
I saved it for our next closing shift when the clearance corner starts fighting us again.
Good. I took a picture before everyone wrecked it because the folded denim plus soft knits actually made sense together.
Fine. I still want something that catches afternoon sun instead of making everything look yellow.
Lunch break in 10. Please say you brought something and are not buying sad mall fries again.
I have the rice bowl from the blue lid container, plus yogurt and an apple. Very responsible for once.
Look at you. Mine is chips from my glove box so do not judge me.
No judgment. I just need this to last through closing or I get cranky at register 3.
Tacos after your shift or are we pretending to be responsible today?
Responsible unfortunately. I packed rice and beans and I am ignoring that green sweater screenshot until Friday.
Walk + phone pics then. No tacos, no checkout button, still dramatic.
Deal. If I mention Target candles, take my phone.
Drive-thru or the little taco spot by Bridge St after your shift?
Little spot. I promised Rosa I would grab cilantro first because cousins are coming over tomorrow.
Fine but I am sending you the video of that lady yelling at the self-checkout while you chop things.
Send it now, I need something funny before I start the rice.
I found that 2020 notes screenshot from your phone: "Yuba campus? Sac room? more store hours?" why were we so dramatic 😭
Do not expose the rent column. I remember adding gas, phone, and Mom's PG&E line like five times.
Did you see the school board thread? My tia sent me three screenshots and everyone is writing novels in the comments.
I saw it because Rosa tagged me under the community page post. I closed the other short-post app after like 20 seconds, it was just quote-posts flying.
I only remember us sitting in the Taco Bell lot and you saying the store manager could put you on mornings if you stayed.
Same. The blue app at least has aunties and people asking normal questions between the chaos lol.
That notebook page had too many arrows and zero confidence.
Exactly. I can handle comments from neighbors better than that scrolling wall of people snapping at each other.
Tacos after your close? Anya said she can do 9:40 if you are not wiped.
Yes to tacos. Janelle might come if fitting rooms do not turn into a disaster zone again.
Good, because Mateo asked if you wanted to join his group for drinks and I already knew your face.
You knew right. Food with you two after work sounds easier than doing stranger introductions tonight.
You still coming for tacos after close or did the bank app ruin your face again?
I checked it like 9 times today and then started doing math in the break room. Very glamorous.
Girl eat first, spiral spreadsheet second. You handled last month too.
I know. I am functional, just annoying in my own head when payments line up weird.
Mija, for the clinic packet just put me under the Mercy General birth line. I can send the photo if you need it.
Yes please. The page asks for parent birthplaces and then those tiny background boxes that never have enough room.
Your dad's old papers say Tashkent, same spelling as before. For my side, ask me before you guess, okay?
Okay. I already wrote a note in the margin because checking one box felt wrong.
Mija, did you get home from closing? I left caldo in the small pot.
Just parked. I am going straight to the shower first, then caldo.
Good. Put the kettle on too. I sliced lemon and left the honey by the mugs.
Thank you. I am doing the towel stretch on the rug while the water heats.
Can you grab me after volleyball at 5:35? Rosa said her office is running late.
Fine, but be outside by the gym doors. I left a burrito wrapped on the middle shelf, eat that before practice.
You put my name on it like I am five.
Because Dilshod ate your pasta last time. Also move your backpack from the hallway before I get back.
Can u grab cereal too? Mom said we’re out
School office gave me the spring sports fee sheet. It asks for a case number again.
Can you get me after volleyball or are you doing the city hall thing
Do you know where Mom put Dad's Tashkent folder? The one with the old stamp and diagrams.
Leave that line empty like last semester. I'll bring cash after my Thursday shift if Mom can't go.
I can grab you at 6:40. I'm trying to hear the part about the bus stops and those awful Garden Hwy lanes before I go.
Try the blue bin under their bed. Why?
I’m stopping at WinCo after work. Send me the actual list, not just cereal.
He needs it for that new badge thing at the loading place. Mom said don't bend it because the paper is ancient.
Also dad asked if u can look at that paper on the fridge when u get back
Why do you care about cones and buses now lol
It's $38. Also I need black socks lol
Text me the photo. I get paid Friday, Mom's front desk check posts tomorrow, and Papa said his shop check clears by then too.
If you find Mom's old campus receipts in there too, leave them. She was sorting them with her check-in window schedule.
Because everyone at work complains and then nobody shows up. Also I want to ask who stores call when someone outside is not okay but yelling at staff.
Fine, but you’re unloading bags this time. I’m not carrying everything in alone again.
The library board has a small booth list for the spring festival. Punjabi sweets, Uzbek bread, banda music, and the Hmong dance group are all on the same page.
That is exactly why I like going here. You walk two blocks and hear three languages before you even get food.
Do you want to meet near Plumas Street after your shift? I can bring the phrase notebook too.
Yes. I know those blocks too well anyway, since every school and apartment in my life has been around here.
That blue zigzag scarf pic you sent would look so good with baggy jeans and the black jacket, not the long skirt lol
Exactly. I want the old pattern to feel like something somebody would actually wear to tacos or a concert.
Also the tiny silver earrings next to it?? Cute. Make a whole rack: scarves, hoops, crossbody bags. I would touch everything.
I saved that combo in the folder. Need to price it like grown-up math, not just vibes.
can u pick me up after volleyball or are you closing again
Can u pick me up after volleyball? Lincoln is blocked by people with signs and news vans
Closing. They moved me to 2-10 with one day's notice, so ask Mom if she can grab you.
Yeah but I'm not getting stuck in that crowd. I'll come around Garden Hwy.
Mom said dont forget the AutoZone bulb thing before they make it a real ticket lol
bruh. also our teacher gave us that ballot sheet and i put the school fees one in your bag lol
I know. The yellow slip is still in my glove box, I'm doing it tomorrow before work.
Good. I wanted to compare it with the clinic funding and rent stuff before I mail mine.
Can you get me after volleyball at 6:20? Also mom said bring tortillas
Yes. I might go the long way by the levee first because the sky looks nice and I have the little Canon in my bag.
Again lol. Don't make me stand there while you chase clouds
Two stops max. If the taco truck has the red awning up I want that for the grid too.
The tiny farming pixel thing you sent has another clip up. Same little piano loop.
Do not mock it, that loop is doing more for this kitchen than the trash you still have not taken out.
Mom is literally stirring beans to it now. Also grandma is clapping off beat.
Perfect. Save the post before it disappears, I want it after dinner when everyone starts telling stories.
I found the little cards from Wednesday. You wrote "yo'q" correctly, but the q sound still made you laugh.
Because my mouth refuses to cooperate after retail voice all day. I can do gracias without thinking, then yo'q makes me restart.
We can do five minutes of that before the next table starts. I will also bring the page with "kak dela" so you stop mixing it with "como estas."
Deal. I will bring coffee and the notebook with the messy columns.
Did you see the county guide page about the sheriff budget thing? My aunt is yelling in the group chat lol
I folded that page. I still need to read the state measure about clinics before I close the envelope.
Same. Also the teacher association list made school board easier for me.
Send me the screenshot after lunch. I want to compare it with the local paper's little writeup.
Mija did the store money show up already? I need to know what you can send for PG&E today.
It landed while I was brushing my teeth. Sending you $185 after I move rent money out.
Good. Keep some for gas too, you have too many closing days this week.
I know. This check covers 68.5 hours, so I’m trying not to touch the grocery cash.
Mija did they give you the little card back at CVS?
Yes, I put it in the envelope with my dental stuff. The pharmacist said arm soreness tonight is normal.
Good. At work today three people came in scared because of some Facebook picture. I told them call their doctor, not your cousin's feed.
Exactly. I found the county FAQ too, way less dramatic than the screenshot Marisol sent.
Coffee after close or are you doing the responsible spreadsheet thing tonight? 😭
Dana was asking who fixed the denim wall after close. I told her it was you with the little color cards.
Spreadsheet. That $80 hits again and my card app is sitting at $602, so coffee has to be break room coffee.
Thank you. I left her a note with the exact time too because I do not want someone else blamed for the mess.
Rude. I respect it though. Clearance rack wages do not deserve cafe prices.
Also your scarf display looked expensive and it was literally clearance scarves 😂
Exactly. I already ignored the left-side ache for months like it was a personality trait, so now I'm behaving.
That is the plan: make clearance look like rent money, then maybe one day make my own rack instead of fixing ours at midnight.
Tell me you saw that lady try to bring back washed curtains with no tag 😭
I had her at lane 3. Receipt lookup, price check, then she wanted the blue vase from the front table too.
The front table actually looked good after you fixed it. Also your little count notes saved me in towels.
I am not repeating the December shelf-number disaster. I wrote down every towel bin before my break.
are you still at the store
Yeah, staying to finish the drawer count. They moved two of Maya's nights onto me until they replace her.
rip. can you still look at my econ thing tomorrow or are you doing your school forms
Both. I want those forms done before the new schedule eats my whole brain.
Send me that wrap thing again, the one with the jalapeno sauce and the girl in the green apron.
The 30 sec one? I saved it right after the try-on with the brown skirt and white tee.
Tacos today or are you doing your levee thing before work?
Tiny loop first. Yesterday's customers are still in my shoulders.
Fine, sweat out the clearance-rack rage and then tacos.
Yes that one. Your saved folder is half food ideas and half people making one shirt look expensive.
Accurate. I need dinner and a clean outfit formula by 3:30.
Deal. If I get called in early, I am switching it to a slow one after closing.
The reel you sent with the cliff overlook was actually pretty. Are we doing snacks-in-the-car plans or just pretending again? 😂
Pretending with tabs open. I saved that loop near Yosemite and one with tasting rooms, but gas money has to behave first.
Okay but if the park page keeps posting waterfalls, I’m blaming them when we end up leaving at 6 a.m.
Fair. You bring the playlist, I’ll bring the iced coffee and the printed map like someone’s auntie.
Mija, can you check the post from Tia Lety about Sunday? She put the address in the event page, not in the family chat.
I found it. Also saw someone selling a folding table nearby, so I saved it in case we need extra space.
Good. Do not get lost in those comments under the city notice again, people are fighting before breakfast.
I won't. That is still calmer than the tiny-post app where the replies move too fast and everyone sounds mad.
Can you drop me at Gauche Park at 5:40? Jay said we only need one more for the net.
Only if your shoes are by the door before 5:30. I am not doing the frantic backpack search again.
Fine. Are you staying too or just being my unpaid driver?
Maybe staying for a few games if my ankle behaves after this morning.
Can I use your laptop for the English thing? Mine is dead.
Only if you don't open ten game tabs. Mine already freezes when Canvas and the bank app are both open.
Lol okay. Also mom said check if your paycheck showed up before she goes to Foods Co.
I checked. I put the grocery number in my note, so don't add snacks like you're rich.
u taking forever in kitchen
Because someone left the pan soaking like a crime scene. I'm making eggs and then doing one round of that tile game, max.
max means 40 minutes for you
Timer is on. After that you can help take trash out and I am putting the phone by the microwave.
For March 21, do you want me to bring the doira video I found, or would that feel too lecture-ish?
Bring it, but only if we can slip it between plov and tea. The aunties will take over anyway.
I also found a 30-second clip from that two-person dev you follow. The melody is weirdly close to the old courtyard recording.
Send that one. I want to compare it before my mom starts assigning chairs.
Coffee after close or are you doing your little bank-app ritual again? 😂
Both maybe. I put $50 aside this morning, so coffee has to be cheap-cheap.
Gas station iced coffee, glamorous. Are you still trying to make the number start with a 2?
Yes, and I am not letting a latte be the reason it crawls backward.
I read the city meeting recap you sent. The part about body cameras being off was frustrating.
Same. It bothers me when the story changes and nobody has to show receipts.
Are you going Saturday, or just watching the stream with your mom?
Probably stream. Big crowds plus work the next morning is too much, but I still want to talk it through.
Mija, before work can you call the office number on the notice? Your dad tried but they talked too fast.
I can call at 1. Is it about the hallway light or the water thing?
Water. Also I put chicken in the fridge if you can start it tonight. I work late.
Ok. I’ll call, then make rice with it when I get home.
The library sale table has two woven pieces today. One has red and cream stitching.
Would it look weird above my dresser? That wall still has the tiny nail holes from the frame I never finished.
Maybe not weird, but check the size. You already have camera batteries and scarves there, yes?
True. I keep picturing it by a bright window with a basil pot instead.
For Saturday's language table, do you want me to print the family tree page with Cyrillic names, or is that too much?
Print it. My dad will laugh if I spell his city wrong again.
The Yuba College page you sent has a night option on Mondays. Did you see the note about prerequisite waivers?
I did. I bookmarked the waiver page and the two store-related classes. I just need my posted hours first.
And for the intro card, maybe write both sides in your own words instead of picking from the preset list.
Yes. The preset list always makes one half disappear.
That makes sense. If you bring the catalog to coffee, I can help you compare the sections.
Thank you. I am trying to pick the one that helps with floor stuff now, not just someday.
Do you still want to practice before Saturday, or are you saving your voice for the Sacramento car ride?
Do you want to walk by Gauche Park after coffee, or is tonight a quiet-at-home night?
Practice tomorrow? Saturday is Mom, Timur, and Elena logistics, plus I promised Marisol I would send road snack opinions.
Walk sounds good. I keep replaying whether I let Janelle down by not taking her Sunday shift.
You can care about her and still protect your day off. Both can be true.
Tomorrow works. Also, my library coworker offered to introduce you to his cousin at the book sale, but I did not answer for you.
Thanks. It is not some permanent fog, just my brain doing the courtroom thing when I think someone is disappointed.
Thank you. I am keeping the book sale for books, coffee, and pronunciation mistakes.
Ok don't yell but my aunt reposted another scary screenshot about the new clinic slots.
Send it if you want, but I'm checking the clinic page before I believe a cropped screenshot with red circles.
Fair. Also city guy at the meeting said the officers 'handled everything perfectly' and everyone was side-eyeing.
Yeah I wait for records and people who were actually there. A podium answer is not enough for me.
Target after your shift or are you staying late to make clothes flirt with each other again? 😂
Only 20 min late. A mom needed pants for a dinner and kept saying no black, so I pulled the brown pair with the blue blouse.
You do that thing where you know what they want before they say it. Kinda scary.
She smiled when I added the gold hoops from the spinner. That counts as a win, now tacos.
Mija, if you pass by the copy place after work, can you print the form for your dad? The supervisor wants his old Tashkent paper with English notes.
Yes. Is he on the early dock shift again?
6 to 2, all those pallets. I go in at 8:30 because Dr. Nguyen moved morning check-ins around and I have to call the no-shows.
Mija, before work can you put the grocery cash in the blue envelope? I only have the clinic deposit pending until noon.
I'll print both forms, his and your class transcript request.
Yes. I counted $116 from my last check and left the school paper with the blank county-number line on the fridge.
Mija, when you get off can you see if Timur finished the rice? I made enough for four bowls.
Gracias. We will do WinCo after my front desk shift, only the list, no extras.
I close at 6. I can check, and I will hide one bowl before he calls it a snack.
I know. After rent and the dental payment this week, the March pile is tight even with all three checks.
Gracias. Dilshod also left the blue envelope by the kettle, do not let it get buried under store receipts.
Got it. I will put it by the keys and make Timur take out the trash before games.
Mija, I found your old folder by the printer. There is a paper with classes and one with that Sacramento bedroom price.
Keep the class one for now. The bedroom one can go, it stressed me out even looking at it.
Okay. Also your 2020 store checks helped us more than you remember. I saved the copies with the bills.
I remember enough. Please don't put that whole pile on my bed lol.
Mija, eat before you go. Those long lines make you shaky.
I packed rice and fruit. I am on floor first, then covering front while Carla does rugs and sheets.
Good. And take the break they give you, okay? After that night in December, I do not like you skipping it.
I know. I have the notebook in my bag too, so I can write counts before anyone asks later.
Mija, are you still going to that cafe thing after work? Eat first, please.
Yes, Anya saved me a seat. I packed crackers and I need to show her how Tia says "buenas noches" so she stops making it fancy.
Ay, poor Anya. And ask her again how to say the soft hello. Your uncle liked when you tried it.
I wrote it next to assalomu alaykum so I do not mix them up.
Can you get me from volleyball at 5:20
Yes but bring the container from lunch. I am not buying you fries again when there is plov at home.
Mom said aunties are coming Sunday and you have to make the tea thing
I know. I already moved my extra shift so I can drive you, finish the table, and still keep Saturday morning for my class videos.
Are we eating the carrot rice thing tonight or is Mom doing beans again
Can I eat the container with the yellow rice or is that yours
Can you get me after volleyball tomorrow or are you doing that late register thing
Take the smaller one. The big one is for tomorrow after my shift.
Both probably. Dad already soaked the rice and Mom asked me to grab masa after work.
Tomorrow I’m 12-7, so I can grab you if you wait by the gym doors.
Is the chicken spicy
Save me the crunchy bottom part if I get back late from volleyball
Ok. Mom said you’re there like all month lol
No, just cumin and coriander. Add the cucumber tomato stuff if you want something cold with it.
Pretty much. My week is 35 hours again unless they add Saturday.
Can u take me to volleyball at 5?
Only if you help move the little table before Tia gets here. She always tells the long stories when the candles are out.
Only if we stop by the library drop box first. I have the signed envelope in my bag.
bruh why are there like 900 papers in that thing
Because Sacramento and Yuba City both want homework from me. Also don't clown me, your school board people were on there.
The spring festival has a 4 pm dance group and food booths. Would you want to walk there from the library?
Yes, walking is better. I can bring the cardamom cookies if my tray survives tonight.
That sounds lovely. Coffee first or after?
After, please. I will need it once I am done packing leftovers for Rosa.
I found the book page with the pomegranate border. The corner shape is very close to the stitching you showed me.
Send it please. I want to try it on the cream tote sketch, but maybe with the cropped vest so it doesn't look like a museum gift.
That contrast makes sense. Traditional line, everyday shape. Do you still want the small card to mention where the motif comes from?
Yes, just a short line. I want people to know it has a story, but I also need it to move off a rack.
Are you still up for the coffee walk, or did closing run late?
Still up for it. I need feet moving before I sit down and disappear into my phone.
Meet by the library entrance at 6:45? We can do the shorter loop if you have dinner to make.
Short loop is perfect. I already texted my mom that I'm not just lying on the floor after work.
That green dress with the straw tote actually made the front table look expensive for once
I moved the lemon candles closer and took a quick snap before we clocked out. The colors looked too good.
Post the before/after but crop out the clearance sign or corporate will haunt us
Already tucked it into my saved folder with the outfit mirror one and the pasta plate from break.
I screenshotted the county guide for you. The clinic one is buried under terrible wording, of course.
Send it. I'm reading on lunch while I eat the sad granola bar of capitalism.
Also did your store people ever explain that break-room meeting? My cousin said hers was about steadier schedules and better checks.
Janelle said just listen first. If it's actually about closes not changing every five seconds, I'm not ignoring it.
Mija, I found your little Rideout bracelet and the paper with September 14, 2002 in the blue folder.
Good, keep it by the lease papers. The clerk asked for anything old with my name.
Also the festival committee left flyers at the clinic. Same street food smells already coming through the lobby, everyone talking about it.
Save me one flyer. I want to see who is performing this year before work posts my schedule.
Mija, are you coming straight home after closing?
I might park by the river for 25 minutes first. Just walking, phone on.
Text me when you get back in the car. Eat the soup when you come home.
I will. I need to cool off before I walk into the house.
The library posted the Nowruz flyer on the Yuba City community page. Did it show up for you?
Yes, between my cousin's baby pictures and a long argument about the county meeting. I clicked interested so I don't lose it.
That feed is chaotic, but at least the event details stay in one place.
Yeah. I tried checking the fast text-only feed for reactions and backed out when the replies started stacking every second.
The Samarkand spring photos you forwarded are beautiful. The blue tile courtyard one made me stop scrolling.
That account keeps posting dancers, bread tables, and flower crowns. I saved too many.
I also found a short article on Merida studios and the old carved facades nearby. It pairs nicely with your Uxmal tab.
Send it. My bookmarks are turning into a tiny passport I cannot afford yet.
Girl those new black sneakers better be magic because fitting rooms looked like a tornado today 😭
They helped more than the cute flats. Still doing my floor stretches before I drive.
I am grabbing coffee but you sound like a soup-and-steam person tonight.
Exactly. Coffee later this week. Tonight is broth, lemon mug, and towel over the bowl.
Your left ankle wrap was peeking out during closing. Did the river path betray you again?
The gravel curve tried it, but I stopped before being dramatic.
Good, because I still need you at the park nets Tuesday. Your serves annoy people in a useful way.
Clearance rack is doing that thing again. The black jeans finally got marked down.
Do not tell me this after that shift. I brought soup so I would not buy cafe food and now jeans are whispering.
I will show up if I can move tomorrow without walking like a folding chair.
I will hide your size behind the ugly capris until payday. Also proud of the soup.
Thank you. My cart already has pillow covers sitting there judging me.
That man by the carts was back after you left. Manager just kept saying call the usual number and I was like for what??
Exactly. He needed somebody calm who knows how to talk him down, not four cars making the whole entrance stare.
Put that in your little meeting notes, miss city agenda
I did. Same page as the mall bus stop and hiring program thing, because all of it hits our store first.
Mija, before your shift can you check if the dentist payment came out? I don't want surprises.
I saw it in the bank categories. I wrote the new leftover number under March bills.
Good. And don't forget your tax thing after work, the paper from your job is still on the table.
I know. I'll enter it tonight if the register drawer doesn't keep me late.
Mija, the tire place called back. They said about $400 if they replace both front ones.
I can pay it today. I just hate pulling that much from the other account.
Then this week no Target, no extra snacks. And ask about one more evening at work, okay?
Okay. If I grab an extra shift and still do the next $50, it should recover.
Did your sprouted wheat turn out this year? Mine looked very dramatic and then collapsed.
Ours is leaning but still alive. Rosa said the table looks wrong without green on it.
That is sweet. Are you bringing the rice dish to the gathering or just helping set up?
Helping, mostly. My aunt wants the candle tray cleaned and my dad is guarding the big pot like usual.
The library table had copies of the county booklet today. Did you already finish yours?
Yes, dropped the envelope last week. I kept the booklet though because the housing measure and water board race were confusing.
I noticed the tenants group and the farmworker clinic both endorsed the same side on that one.
That helped. I still read the opposition paragraph because sometimes the wording is sneaky.
Mija, did you see the clip your aunt sent? Your tio is already arguing in the family chat.
I saw. I told him the badge camera should decide it, not people picking sides before the full video.
Good. Also did they clear that paper from your brake light stop now?
Yeah, bulb replaced and receipt saved. It was just the warning, nothing else.
If you still want a quiet walk, the river path near Shanghai Bend should be less windy before noon.
Perfect. I want to bring the tiny camera and try the old signs by the water before the sun gets harsh.
Send me the one with the best colors later. Your last cafe window picture made me notice that place differently.
I might put that one with the blue scarf slide after it if they match.
Clearance rack survived barely. Coffee or are you running home?
Coffee, but quick. I need to ask Marisol if she still has that Target coupon and send Anya the phrase list.
Fine, responsible queen. Also Devon from shoes asked if you were coming to karaoke Friday.
Only if you, Marisol, or Anya go. I am not spending my Friday being passed to some random shoes guy.
Girl, why did Carla hand you the fitting room keys AND the return pile tonight 😭
Because apparently if I can survive three nights of abandoned carts, I can survive anything.
Your old badge photo is on the corkboard in the break room again 😂 2020 Saba looks like she was about to fight the clearance rack.
You did run that new girl through sizes without sounding mean, so I see the vision.
That badge was from the week I stopped pretending I had a neat little five-year map.
I am keeping notes. If I ever have my own little rack with clean lighting, nobody is folding denim like that.
Honestly same. The only map here is fitting rooms, register backup, and payday.
Payday was doing a lot of heavy lifting back then.
Mija, you left those store photos on the kitchen table. The one with the red tags looks very neat.
Can you leave them there? I want to copy the numbers from the register sheet onto the back before work.
Okay. Eat something too. Are those for your meeting with the manager?
Just in case she asks what I changed. The before picture was messy sizes, then I grouped the softer stuff and lighter shades together.
Can you get me after volleyball at 5:40
Yes but no drive-thru. I moved $25 to the card because it's still around $590 after the clinic draft.
i have granola bars anyway
Good. Also remind me not to chew on that side when we get home. I keep forgetting.
Mom says bring the pan dulce tray and Dad says don't forget the green tea tin from the tall cabinet.
Tell them yes. Also ask Dad if his old passport copy is still in the blue folder.
He said Tashkent page? And Mom said why are you doing paperwork during dinner.
Because the form gives me three tiny squares and a blank line like that's enough for this family.
Would you still like to walk before language practice tomorrow? We can meet near the library instead of the coffee place.
Library is better. I have a full thermos and I am trying not to make a $6 stop look tiny.
That works. I will bring the book list, and we can avoid the shops on Plumas after.
Please. The window dress on that boutique already got me to pause twice.
I found the word you asked about. The stamp on your dad's paper looks like Toshkent, not Samarqand.
That helps. He remembers the teacher making them redraw the pulley parts until they were perfect.
Bring a photo next time and I'll help with the handwriting. Also, your mom's class receipt says Tuesday nights, right?
Yes, before she started covering the patient window full time.
Did the library site finally load on your computer, or should I send the reading as a PDF?
PDF please. The old laptop does that helicopter sound when two tabs and my notes are open.
The account you showed me with the embroidered vests also posted a packing-orders video. The tags on the parcels were beautiful.
Sent. Also, I found a used Dell listing near Plumas Street if you decide to look after payday.
Right? I like when they show the back table, steamers, receipt printer, all of it.
Maybe after I sort the work deposit and the grocery line in the bank app.
It made me understand why you notice store displays so quickly.
Those little accounts teach more than the big glossy posts sometimes.
Coffee after close or are you sprinting home?
Coffee after close or are you doing the gym pickup thing again?
